segments.text: Engilis tiri orga tamiz digan elallani kob kordiz. Bizan yan brinch mati kor mi hapsiz. Lekin Englify ozi nimaqil aliydi, qanag natiji bir aliydi.
Mana misalchum bizni suni intelekt yardamidi qiligan speaking fung tamiz. O aynam uzbeklar uchun sozlangan, va noldan erkin gaprish kecham abchqa alaydi. Mana oiz korin.
Hello, let's talk about best friends. Who is your best friend?
That's great. What do you like to do together with Asad?
I want to go to PC game club with him and play Counter-Strike.
Bu, ond te funksiyamizdan bit das khalas.
Xamasnon uziz faydalanib korchi uschunt xabarons tige.
